You are comfortable setting direction and standards, then rolling up sleeves to make them real on site. You create structure where sometimes none exists, challenge vendors and assumptions constructively, and prioritize resilience and availability over theoretical completeness. Quality Assurance & Standards

title: IT-Systemadministrator (m/w/d) – Infrastruktur & IT-Sicherheit  / Teilzeit (20 Std./Woche)
description:
Über CUREosity

CUREosity ist ein innovatives Med-Tech-Startup aus Düsseldorf, das die Gesundheitsbranche mit Virtual-Reality-Therapien revolutioniert. Unsere mehrfach ausgezeichneten Lösungen verbessern die Rehabilitation für Patient*innen weltweit.
Damit wir auch technologisch weiter wachsen können, suchen wir Verstärkung für unsere interne IT. In dieser vielseitigen Rolle entwickelst du unsere bestehende IT-Landschaft weiter und arbeitest an abwechslungsreichen Themen rund um moderne Infrastrukturen, sichere Netzwerke, Cybersecurity, Cloud-Technologien und die Digitalisierung unserer Unternehmensprozesse. Dabei übernimmst du eigenständig Verantwortung und setzt gemeinsam mit verschiedenen Teams zukunftsfähige IT-Lösungen um. Bei der Verteilung deiner Arbeitszeit sind wir flexibel und stimmen gemeinsam ein Modell ab, das zu dir und unserem Team passt.

Was uns ausmacht

  • Innovative Technologie: Wir setzen auf VR für bessere Therapieergebnisse
  • Teamgeist und Vielfalt: Ein diverses, internationales Team mit unterschiedlichen Perspektiven und Hintergründen
  • Start-Up Atmosphäre: Flache Hierarchien, kurze Kommunikationswege und viel Gestaltungsspielraum

Bist du bereit, mit uns die Zukunft der Rehabilitation zu gestalten?

Deine Mission

  • Du betreust unsere Unternehmens-IT und entwickelst bestehende Systeme und Strukturen gemeinsam mit dem Team weiter.
  • Netzwerk-, Server- und Cloud-Infrastrukturen administrierst du zuverlässig und unterstützt bei deren Optimierung.
  • Du setzt Maßnahmen im Bereich IT-Sicherheit und Cybersecurity um und wirkst an der Weiterentwicklung unserer Sicherheitsstandards mit.
  • Firewalls, VPNs und weitere Sicherheitslösungen werden von dir betreut und kontinuierlich überwacht.
  • Du analysierst digitale Geschäftsprozesse und unterstützt dabei, geeignete Automatisierungsmöglichkeiten zu identifizieren und umzusetzen.
  • Neue Technologien und IT-Lösungen prüfst du auf ihren Nutzen und begleitest deren Einführung.
  • Bei der Entwicklung interner Softwarelösungen und Automatisierungen bringst du deine technischen Ideen ein.
  • Gemeinsam mit Entwicklung, Support und Operations setzt du bereichsübergreifende IT-Themen um.
  • IT-Projekte übernimmst du eigenständig und bringst sie strukturiert zum Abschluss.

Dein Profil

  • Du hast eine Ausbildung als Fachinformatiker*in, ein Studium im IT-Bereich oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation erfolgreich abgeschlossen.
  • Du bringst mindestens zwei Jahre Berufserfahrung im IT-Bereich mit.
  • Mit modernen Unternehmensnetzwerken, Serverlandschaften und Netzwerkarchitekturen kennst du dich gut aus.
  • Du verfügst über praktische Kenntnisse in den Bereichen Cybersecurity, Firewalls, Routing und VPN.
  • Idealerweise hast du bereits mit Cloud-Technologien und modernen Microsoft-Lösungen wie Microsoft 365, Entra ID oder Azure gearbeitet.
  • Neue Technologien rund um Cloud, KI und Automatisierung wecken dein Interesse.
  • Eine analytische, strukturierte und eigenverantwortliche Arbeitsweise zeichnet dich aus.
  • Du kommunizierst sehr sicher auf Deutsch und verfügst über gute Englischkenntnisse. Bei uns hast du die Chance, wirklich etwas zu bewegen und zu gestalten. Die „Grüne Wiese“ wartet auf deine Ideen und Initiative. Werde Teil unseres dynamischen Teams und gestalte die Zukunft der Med-Tech-Branche aktiv mit!

Unsere Benefits

  • Betriebliche Altersvorsorge: Sichere deine Zukunft mit unserer Unterstützung.
  • Monatlich steuerfreier Sachbezug: Zusätzliche finanzielle Benefits, flexibel einsetzbar.
  • Gesundheits- und Fitnessangebote: Vergünstigter Zugang zu Sport-, Fitness- und Wellnessangeboten – digital oder vor Ort.
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten: Gestalte deine Arbeit so, dass sie zu deinem Leben passt.
  • Tierfreundliches Büro: Hunde sind bei uns herzlich willkommen.
  • Regelmäßige Team-Events: Austausch, Zusammenhalt und gemeinsame Erlebnisse gehören für uns dazu.

Unsere Werte

Win as a team – Be brave & collaborate: Erfolgreich sind wir nur im Team. Jede*r bringt einzigartige Fähigkeiten mit, und in einer ergebnisorientierten, offenen und kreativen Zusammenarbeit ergänzen wir uns optimal.

Ownership - See the bigger picture and mission: Verantwortung für das eigene Handeln, das Wohl des Teams und des Unternehmens zu übernehmen ist uns wichtig. Probleme sehen wir als Chancen zur Lösung.

Stay Hungry - Take continuous change as a business driver: Stetige Weiterentwicklung und Offenheit für Veränderungen sind unsere Treiber. Kreativer Hunger nach neuen Impulsen ermöglicht uns kontinuierliches Wachstum.

Respekt - Spread positivity - not politics: Offenheit, Positivität und Wertschätzung prägen unsere Interaktionen. Vielfalt in Meinungen und Ideen bereichert unser Team.

Unser Bewerbungsprozess

1. Review: Wir prüfen deine Bewerbung und achten besonders auf deine Motivation.

2. Kennenlernen: In zwanglosen Gesprächen – online und vor Ort.

3. Angebot: Bei beidseitigem Interesse freuen wir uns dich bald in unserem Team begrüßen zu dürfen!

Starte jetzt deine Karriere bei CUREosity und verändere mit uns die Gesundheitsbranche!

title: IT Security Engineer till internationell high-tech-miljö
description: Vill du arbeta brett inom cybersäkerhet och få möjlighet att påverka hur en säker IT-miljö faktiskt byggs upp? Här kliver du in i en teknikintensiv och internationell verksamhet där robusthet, säkerhet och tillgänglighet är avgörande – och där du får arbeta hands-on med allt från säkerhetsövervakning och identitetshantering till nätverk, cloud och endpoint security. Det här är en möjlighet för dig som vill mer än att enbart förvalta befintliga säkerhetslösningar. Du kommer in i ett skede där mycket redan finns på plats, samtidigt som det finns stor möjlighet att vidareutveckla, strukturera och sätta din prägel på hur organisationen arbetar med IT-säkerhet framåt. Om tjänsten Som IT Security Engineer får du en bred teknisk roll i gränslandet mellan cybersäkerhet, nätverk och modern IT-infrastruktur. Verksamheten består av flera typer av tekniska miljöer – bland annat utvecklings-, produktions- och kontorsmiljöer – där säkerheten behöver fungera både i cloud och i fysisk infrastruktur. Det som särskiljer möjligheten är bredden. I stället för att arbeta med en avgränsad del av cybersäkerhet får du följa säkerheten hela vägen – från nätverk och endpoints till identitet, cloud, loggning och compliance. Du kommer dessutom in i en organisation med avancerad egen teknik, internationella samarbeten och höga krav på säkerhet och robusthet. Säkerhetsarbetet är under fortsatt utveckling, vilket innebär att du inte bara tar över någon annans lösning – du får vara med och forma hur den ska se ut framåt. För rätt person finns därför stora möjligheter att både bredda sin tekniska kompetens och få ett betydande ansvar inom ett område som står högt på agendan. Arbetsuppgifter En stor del av rollen handlar om att säkerställa att rätt säkerhetsnivå finns på plats när nya miljöer, system och tekniska lösningar etableras. Det kan exempelvis innebära att sätta upp säkerhetsövervakning och loggning för en ny miljö, konfigurera nätverkssegment och brandväggsregler, säkra klienter och servrar eller säkerställa rätt behörigheter i Azure. Du kommer samtidigt att vara med och utveckla organisationens övergripande säkerhetsförmåga. Här finns utrymme att identifiera förbättringsområden, föreslå lösningar och omsätta säkerhetskrav och ramverk till praktisk teknik. Rollen innebär även nära samarbete med tekniska kollegor internationellt, vilket ger dig möjlighet att arbeta med säkerhetsfrågor över flera miljöer och geografier. Exempel på arbetsuppgifter: Bygga vidare på organisationens lösningar för säkerhetsövervakning, logghantering och SIEM Säkerställa att klienter och servrar har rätt skydd, exempelvis EDR, säkerhetssensorer och loggning Arbeta med segmentering av nätverk samt konfigurera switchar, brandväggar och säkerhetsregler Hantera identiteter, roller, behörigheter och åtkomst i Azure Arbeta med endpoint management och säkerhetspolicies, exempelvis genom Intune Delta vid etablering av nya tekniska miljöer och säkerställa att security by design genomsyrar lösningen Arbeta med sårbarhetshantering, härdning och andra tekniska säkerhetsåtgärder Dokumentera förändringar, säkerhetskonfigurationer och arbetssätt Bidra till att utveckla organisationens säkerhetsarbete utifrån etablerade ramverk och compliance-krav Vi söker dig somHar relevant eftergymnasial utbildning inom IT, cybersäkerhet eller motsvarande Har praktisk, hands-on erfarenhet av IT- eller cybersäkerhet i säkerhetskritiska miljöer, gärna från försvarsindustrin eller andra säkerhetskänsliga miljöer Har mycket goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska Det är meriterande om du tidigare har arbetat i exempelvis en SOC, varit med och byggt upp eller utvecklat en IT-säkerhetsmiljö eller har erfarenhet av Azure, Intune och moderna cloudmiljöer. Vi tror att du är nyfiken på hela säkerhetsområdet och gillar att förstå hur tekniken faktiskt hänger ihop. Du behöver inte vilja nischa dig mot endast ett verktyg eller en del av cybersäkerheten – tvärtom passar rollen dig som tycker om kombinationen av nätverk, cloud, klienter, identitet och säkerhetsövervakning. Du är initiativtagande och bekväm med att identifiera vad som behöver förbättras, komma med förslag och själv driva arbetet framåt. Samtidigt arbetar du strukturerat och förstår vikten av dokumentation, spårbarhet och tydliga processer i en säkerhetskritisk miljö. Framför allt motiveras du av möjligheten att vara med och bygga. Här finns stor frihet att påverka hur säkerhetsmiljön ska utvecklas, och bra idéer har kort väg från förslag till genomförande. title: Offensive Security Engineer
description: About the role Mission Strengthen Sporty’s offensive security posture by proactively testing and identifying vulnerabilities across our external perimeter, standalone virtual private servers (VPS), physical office infrastructure, and endpoint defenses. The Offensive Security Engineer owns the security testing, continuous perimeter monitoring, and reconnaissance across all Sporty Group external domains, websites, public IP blocks, and DNS configurations. This role works closely with IT, Network Engineering, SOC, and Security teams to convert external discovery, adversary emulation on EDR/XDR systems, and exploitation insights into tuned perimeter controls, firewall rules, and robust defensive guardrails. What you'll be doing Monitor, map, and test Sporty’s entire external attack surface, including all Sporty Group external domains, subdomains, websites, and public IP addresses. Conduct adversary emulation exercises against internal and office endpoints to validate the effectiveness of EDR, XDR, and SOC monitoring platforms. Evaluate the security posture of physical office hardware, corporate network equipment, and internal edge infrastructure. Perform scoped offensive testing on external-facing web applications and limited, public-facing API endpoints. Translate external discovery, DNS security posture, network access control weaknesses, and EDR emulation findings into repeatable defensive checks. Support our Purple Team validate that EDR policies, perimeter controls, firewall rules, and network segmentation work as expected. Document multi-stage network or system exploitation chains to provide practical, reproducible remediation blueprints for infrastructure and SOC teams. Support IT and Network analysts with clear vulnerability descriptions, triage steps, severity logic, and escalation guidance. Improve external asset tracking, perimeter health records, and exposure trend mapping. Track external vulnerability gaps, emulation success rates, remediation times, asset health, and perimeter exposure. What you'll bring Experience in offensive security, perimeter penetration testing, network security assessments, or adversary emulation. Strong understanding of external asset discovery, DNS configuration vulnerabilities, and public IP network routing. Practical experience auditing and testing Linux and Windows environments and underlying network services. Ability to perform adversary emulation and bypass techniques against modern EDR/XDR solutions. Familiarity with testing physical office network hardware, routers, switches, firewalls, and workplace IT systems. Ability to turn external exposures and technical network risks into clear, actionable fixes for IT and Security teams. Experience with core web vulnerabilities and limited, scoped testing of modern API interfaces. Strong scripting ability in Python, PowerShell, Bash, or similar to automate perimeter mapping, emulation workflows, and asset discovery. Good understanding of scanning, reconnaissance, and interception tools. Strong documentation skills. Technology Expertise Any of the following: Kali Linux toolset, Nmap, Shodan, Censys, Masscan, Amass, Dig/DNS testing tools, Wireshark, Burp Suite, OWASP ZAP, Microsoft Defender XDR, CrowdStrike Falcon, SentinelOne, Atomic Red Team, Caldera, Python, PowerShell, Bash, VPS environments (Linux/Windows Server OS), Firewalls, Routers, Git, Jira, Confluence What's in it for you Sporty is a remote-first company in pursuit of sustainability A competitive salary plus individual performance-based bonuses every quarter 28 days paid annual leave Core working hours of 10am-3pm in your local time zone, with flexibility outside of these hours Referral bonuses and flash bonuses Top-of-the-line equipment Annual company retreats that provide opportunities to connect and collaborate with colleagues from around the world Interview Process: Remote video screening with our Talent Acquisition Team Online assessment via Hackerrank Remote video interview with Team Members (60 Mins) Final discussion with the hiring manager (60 mins) If you're interested, we encourage you to apply. title: Security & Compliance Engineer - Remote Germany
description: About Linro Linro is a cloud security company building a real-time, agentic cloud-security platform. Teams ship with AI. AI ships with Linro. Cloud infrastructure changes constantly, and increasingly it's AI agents making those changes, not people. Most security tools only catch problems after the fact. Linro works differently. We enforce what's allowed at every stage, from commit to production. We stop bad changes before they ship, and fix problems in real time once they're live. We have each been on the receiving end of this problem: running cloud security at scale, building the platforms underneath it, and shipping in regulated systems where a wrong change isn't an option. Founded in Berlin in 2026 and built fully remote across Europe, Linro has a platform that's real and working, with plenty still to shape. The role You will own Linro's security and compliance program end to end, starting from a blank page. Your job is to build that from scratch: figure out where we actually stand, find the gaps, and close them across a multi-cloud environment. Automate what can be automated instead of redoing the same work by hand every quarter. What you will do Take SOC2, ISO 27001 and 42001 from a blank page to audit-ready . Run the gap analysis, document controls and policies, gather and map evidence, track remediation to done, and get us through audit. Automate compliance instead of just babysitting it: build checks and guardrails so we stay continuously compliant, and help ensure our multi-cloud infrastructure (AWS and beyond) is managed as Infrastructure-as-Code with Terraform. Own our compliance evidence end to end: keep it current, mapped, and audit-ready across whatever tooling we run. Support security operations : monitoring, alert triage, and documenting findings. Stay close to how the product is actually built . Our compliance checks run on the same engine we sell customers, so you are testing the product, not filling out paperwork off to the side. What we are looking for Hands-on experience with at least one of SOC 2, ISO 27001, or ISO 42001: you have run a gap analysis, built and mapped evidence, and taken a program through an actual audit, not just studied the framework. Experience across more than one is a plus. Genuine interest in cloud and information security, governance, and compliance, and the drive to own outcomes, not just tasks. Comfort reading cloud configurations and IaC across multiple providers. Ability to automate scales with level. Careful, structured, and trustworthy. You will handle sensitive material. Nice to have Hands-on Terraform, and experience with AWS, GCP, and/or Azure. Exposure to a compliance automation platform. Prior general software engineering experience, ideally in the stacks we use day to day (Go, SQL, and cloud infrastructure) How we work We are 100% remote across Europe and hire anywhere within roughly two hours of Central European Time (CEST). We get the whole team together in person somewhere in Europe once a quarter for a few days. We work async by default, write things down, and protect people's focus time. What we offer Real ownership of the security and compliance program from the ground up. Meaningful equity. You are an early employee, and your stake reflects it. Competitive salary, benchmarked to the market. A quarterly European offsite, and a team that takes both the mission and each other’s time seriously. The honest version This is early, we are literally at the start today. You would start from a blank page, not maintain someone else's polished program. That is the appeal if you want to build a security and compliance function from scratch and carry it all the way to real certifications. It is daunting if you are looking for a mature program to step into. We hire at multiple levels, so this can be a first serious role or a senior mandate. Either way, you will own real outcomes fast. Guard data hygiene like it's the family silver: deliverability, deduplication, opt-outs, sender reputation. Tell the truth in numbers. title: Software Engineer (Backend)
description: About ExTrac ExTrac is a decision intelligence company used by governments, defence organisations, financial institutions, and corporates operating in complex, fast-moving environments. Our capabilities fuse curated data sources, domain-specific AI, and deep human expertise to transform information overload into clear, actionable foresight. Our ambition is to become the analytical backbone that organisations rely on when geopolitical uncertainty becomes an opportunity or a strategic risk. More at extrac.ai . The Role We are looking for a Software Engineer to join ExTrac's engineering team to help build and operate the services and pipelines the platform runs on. ExTrac takes a continuously ingested, multi-source corpus and turns it into products analysts use to make decisions under time pressure. You will help build and run the backend microservices that make that possible: services and databases that expose curated data through APIs, run search and aggregation over large indices, hold application state, and keep the whole thing fast and correct as volume and customer count grow. The work is broad by design. In a single quarter it spans API and service design, search and database performance, long-running data pipelines, cloud infrastructure, and the deployment tooling underneath all of it. You will own well-defined features and components end to end within a single system across a Go and Python codebase, working alongside the AI team who build our analytical and agentic features, the frontend team who build the web and mobile interfaces, and the analysts and product managers who define what gets built. What the job involves Service design and delivery Build and own features, components, and APIs end to end within a single system, taking responsibility for your work and its place within the overall architecture. Contribute to system design and architecture discussions, and take on more of the design work as you build context and scope. Build and maintain APIs used by internal teams and customers, following established contracts and versioning conventions. Production engineering Develop Go and Python-based microservices to support data collection, processing, and querying, with guidance from senior engineers on more complex components. Help hold services to production standards for latency, cost, and reliability, and build the instrumentation to know when they are not meeting them. Build and operate high-throughput data streaming pipelines and work on improving scalability, robustness, and latency. Help optimise databases and index performance where it is the constraint on product behaviour. Working with analysts, product, and other engineering teams Work directly with the analysts who use our products, turning what they hit in practice into changes in the system. Iterate quickly against a live stream of product requests, flagging where they collide with longer-horizon platform work. Partner with the AI and frontend teams to deliver cross-functional features, working through the engineering, performance, and reliability problems that sit outside of their scope. Contribute to the shared foundations other engineers depend on: deployment pipelines, service templates, observability, and the environments their work runs in. You should apply if You have built and worked on production backend systems. You will spend your time working on Go and Python services, databases, and APIs, and you know the difference between something that works on a laptop and something that holds up under production load, latency, and cost. You can work independently on well-defined problems, and know when to flag ambiguity or ask for input rather than guessing. When the obvious approach fails, you look for another one before escalating. You are happy to take the initiative in order to complete a task, whether that means learning a new skill, reaching out to stakeholders to clarify requirements, or suggesting an alternate approach. You treat quality, security, and observability as engineering fundamentals rather than optional extras, and you flag technical debt rather than letting it accumulate silently. You actively seek feedback and act on it, and you look for opportunities to pair with and learn from the engineers around you. You want to work on things that matter. Our software sits underneath decisions taken by governments, defence organisations, and institutions operating where being wrong or late carries real consequences. Where this role can take you Deepen your ownership. Strong performance means ownership over larger sections of the platform, more architectural say over how our services evolve, and more influence over which problems we take on. Breadth rather than a narrow track. The work follows the problem, which means service design one month and pipeline or infrastructure work the next. Engineers here have the opportunity to build depth across several areas rather than being funnelled into one. Progression based on impact. Progress by taking on bigger problems. What moves you to Senior here is the scope you can own end to end and the judgement you show when the answer isn't obvious, not time served. Requirements Due to the nature of our work and the clients we support, applicants must be eligible to obtain UK security clearance. We are currently only able to consider applicants who are nationals of a NATO member state, Australia, or New Zealand. 2+ years of professional software engineering experience, with demonstrated ability to build and ship production-grade services, and experience owning features or components end to end within a larger system. Proficiency in building microservices using Go or Python, with the ability to pick up the other quickly. Practical understanding of software engineering patterns. Strong communication and collaboration skills. Comfortable writing clear technical documentation and discussing requirements with colleagues from engineering and the wider team. Interest across the stack: an interest in deployment pipelines, database behaviour, and security engineering. An interest in how the product is actually used, and a willingness to take analyst feedback into requirements discussions rather than treating requirements as someone else's problem. Desirable Currently working with Go-based microservices. Experience with Elasticsearch and/or PostgreSQL. Experience with cloud infrastructure and infrastructure as code, and with the CI/CD pipelines around them. Experience with streaming or event-driven pipelines. Experience with feature flags and trunk-based development. Features land close to weekly, and individual deploys go out several times a day across several projects. Experience working in software for defence, government, or other compliance-constrained environments. Flexible working, with the opportunity to spend up to 3 days a week remotely alongside regular days with our team in our central London office. title: Business Development Representative
description: About League League is one of the fastest-growing technology companies in Canada and the leading healthcare experience platform. Getting healthcare is often the easy part — finishing it is where things fall apart: people book the appointment and skip the follow-up, fill the prescription and stop taking it, get the referral and never make the call. That gap costs health plans and health systems money, and it costs people their health. League closes that gap — identifying what each person needs to do next, clearing what’s in their way, and getting it done, for the 70 million+ people whose care already runs through our platform. Health plans and health systems trust us to do this at scale. Organizations like Manulife, SCAN, Geisinger, and Medibank on the payer side, and Baptist and Shoppers Drug Mart on the provider side. Position Summary: This is a build-your-craft role at the front of League's enterprise motion. You will work alongside two to three Account Directors, prospecting into their assigned book of business as the first point of contact between League and healthcare executives owning digital, member experience, AI initiatives, and innovation across North America. Your core responsibility is conducting deep account research to map League's value proposition to real organizational challenges, then deploying agentic outreach sequences across email, LinkedIn, and direct calls to create discovery meetings and pipelines. League is an AI-first company and this role is built that way. You will have the tools to research and sequence at a depth that used to take a team, and the support to keep improving how you use them. Your central mandate is to run League's go-to-market system with rigor, and to make it better from the inside. What You'll Own Account research and point of view Research accounts in your Account Directors' book at the level of their actual business: quality performance, digital and AI roadmaps, recent leadership changes, earnings commentary, public filings and app store reviews. Map League's value proposition to account-specific challenges to build points of view that drive early engagement. Bring League executives and subject matter experts into accounts where a peer-level conversation opens a door that a rep cannot. Outreach and pipeline creation Build and deploy agentic outreach sequences on League's technology stack, across email, LinkedIn and direct calls. Generate discovery meetings and pipeline while providing Account Directors with high-context research for first calls. Support marketing events, campaigns and initiatives where League's prospects are a good fit, and follow up on the interest they generate. The system itself Execute the go-to-market system with discipline while refining underlying AI workflows, skills, and agents, and share what works with the rest of the team. Partner with the Marketing team to analyze and iterate on market messaging. Keep Salesforce accurate and current, because pipeline decisions above you are made from what you record. Learn the enterprise sales motion end to end, from first touch through opportunity progression. Security-related responsibilities: Ensure access management is performed in compliance with your role and responsibilities. Execute League's policies and procedures within your team and engagements. Notify HR, Legal, Compliance & Security of any incidents, breaches, or policy violations. Comply with Information Security Policies. What You'll Bring Two+ years of outbound sales experience into large enterprises (ideally healthcare). We are hiring for trajectory, not tenure. A genuine, organic interest in building a sales development career. Track record of reaching and engaging executive-level buyers. Fluency with Claude or other AI-native tools, and evidence you fold them into your day-to-day rather than treating them as an add-on. Strong written communication. Real curiosity about healthcare and how it is changing. You do not need to know the US healthcare system on day one; you do need to be the kind of person who goes and learns it. Experience with long, committee-driven enterprise sales cycles. Experience working alongside senior sellers on account strategy. Opportunities you source advance past first meeting because you stayed in the account and helped shape qualification. The system gets sharper. title: Full Stack Engineer
description: Build the technology behind the teams transforming construction At XYZ Reality , we’ve created the world’s first engineering-grade Augmented Reality solution for construction. Our product, The Atom, is used on major projects worldwide to bring designs to life on-site and help teams build more accurately, efficiently and with fewer mistakes. As a Series B business scaling across the UK, US and Europe, we’re not only evolving the technology our customers use, we’re also investing in the tools and applications that enable our own teams to operate effectively as we grow. We’re looking for a Full Stack Engineer to take ownership of the internal applications, dashboards and AI-enabled tools that help power XYZ Reality behind the scenes. The Role This is a great opportunity for a Full Stack Engineer who enjoys building useful products, solving real business problems and owning what they create from idea through to production. As XYZ has grown, teams across the business have increasingly developed applications, dashboards, automations and AI-enabled tools to solve problems and improve how they work. We now need an engineer who can bring technical ownership to this space – taking promising ideas and prototypes and turning them into secure, scalable and maintainable applications. You’ll work directly with teams across XYZ to understand what they need, translate those requirements into technical solutions and build applications that people across the business will genuinely use. Because these tools can interact with employee, user and potentially customer data, you’ll also ensure they are built and deployed properly, with security, maintainability and appropriate engineering standards considered from the outset. This is a role with plenty of autonomy. You’ll own applications end-to-end, from architecture and data model through to UI, deployment, monitoring and ongoing iteration. And when internal priorities allow, you’ll have the opportunity to contribute your Full Stack skills to our wider product engineering team and the technology behind XYZ Reality’s engineering-grade AR platform. The role is based in London on a hybrid basis, ideally 2–3 days per week in the office, enabling you to work directly with the teams you’ll be building for while retaining flexibility. What You’ll Be Doing Design, build and maintain internal business applications end-to-end, from data model and architecture through to user interface. Take ownership of existing prototypes, dashboards and tools and evolve them into secure, reliable and maintainable applications. Ship quickly using modern serverless and Backend-as-a-Service platforms such as Vercel, Supabase and Firebase. Build applications using TypeScript/JavaScript, React/Next.js and Node.js. Integrate AI capabilities, including LLM APIs, automation and agents, to improve and streamline business workflows. Work directly with stakeholders across XYZ to understand problems, gather requirements and translate business needs into practical technical solutions. Own the full application lifecycle, including architecture, development, deployment, monitoring, maintenance and iteration. Ensure appropriate security and data protection standards are built into applications handling employee, user or customer information. Implement authentication, SSO and identity management where required. Champion good engineering practices across code quality, testing, security and CI/CD. Build integrations between internal systems, data sources and third-party platforms. Use feedback and usage data to continually improve the applications you build. Evaluate emerging technologies and AI capabilities and identify where they can genuinely improve how XYZ operates. Contribute to our wider product engineering environment when capacity allows. What We’re Looking For Demonstrable in-depth professional software engineering experience, ideally within a Full Stack role. Strong proficiency in TypeScript/JavaScript and modern web development. Hands-on experience with React/Next.js and Node.js. Experience building and deploying applications using platforms such as Vercel, Supabase, Firebase or equivalent modern technologies. Experience owning applications beyond the initial build – including deployment, maintenance, monitoring and ongoing improvement. Comfortable integrating AI/LLM services into applications and using modern AI tooling as part of your development workflow. Experience implementing authentication and identity management, such as OAuth/OIDC, SAML or SSO. A good understanding of application security and how to appropriately handle sensitive business and user data. Strong software engineering fundamentals, with an appreciation for maintainable code, testing and good development practices. Comfortable working directly with non-technical stakeholders and turning their requirements into effective technical solutions. Able to work autonomously, prioritise effectively and take ownership of the applications you build. Experience within a startup, scale-up or modern technology environment would be particularly valuable, as would experience with Postgres/SQL, row-level security, data visualisation, reporting or workflow automation. We’re looking for a strong Full Stack Engineer with solid fundamentals who is comfortable learning new tools and making pragmatic technology choices based on the problem being solved. Above all, we’re looking for someone who enjoys building things that make a difference, an engineer who can take an idea or prototype, understand the problem behind it and turn it into technology the business can rely on. What You Could Be Working On From the outset, you could be working across projects including: Internal business applications and operational tools AI-enabled workflows and automation Business dashboards and reporting Employee and talent applications Data-driven internal tools Integrations between business platforms Secure applications handling employee, user and customer data Prototypes that need to evolve into scalable, production-ready applications As our internal technology needs continue to evolve, so will the problems you have the opportunity to solve. You’ll be an integral part of the Sales team, working to ensure technical fit and create innovative solutions for our customers. Your attention to detail, focused on customer needs, will ultimately improve retention and overall success. This role will be based from our London office or Dublin office with an office-centric hybrid schedule. The standard in-office days are Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday. GRC practitioners are especially encouraged to apply—whether you've managed GRC programmes in-house, audited them as an internal or external auditor, or helped customers meet their GRC programme needs at a GRC vendor, you'll bring exactly the customer empathy and domain fluency this role thrives on. What you’ll do as a Solutions Engineer at Vanta: Serve as a strategic sales partner, owning the technical relationship with prospects and customers. Strategic Discovery and Deal Qualification: Partner with Account Executives to uncover technical, operational, and business pain points, validating use cases and aligning solutions to measurable customer impact and urgency. Secure the Solution Win and Alignment: Validate technical feasibility, drive clarity on success criteria, and guide stakeholders toward a shared vision for the end-to-end solution (The Solution Win: Desirable, Viable, and Aligned). High-Impact Technical Validation: Deliver tailored, narrative-driven demonstrations that showcase how Vanta solves the customer's specific problem, including how Vanta automates and operationalises their GRC programmes across frameworks such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, and HIPAA. Validate the feasibility of standard and semi-complex integrations and confirm alignment with customer environments, workflows, and architectures. Solution Strategy and Deal Shaping: Partner with the Account Executive to align the customer's success criteria with Vanta's unique strengths, proactively surface technical risks, and propose clear pathways to ensure focused deal progression and mutual success. Post-Sale Handoff and Continuity: Ensure a seamless transition to the post-sales team by creating and completing a handoff document that captures the finalised solution design, expectations, and any known risks or constraints. Cross-Functional Feedback: Act as a trusted technical voice, listening carefully to customers to provide structured market feedback to the Product team to prioritise functionality and drive sales opportunities. Support customers throughout their trial process with Vanta. Cultivate an environment of teamwork, openness, creativity, and continuous improvement. How to be successful in this role: Must be able to work in our London office 3 days a week (Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday). </ul> <h3><strong>What you’ll bring</strong></h3> <ul> <li> <p>Experience building and maintaining backend applications with Ruby on Rails.</p> </li> <li> <p>Experience delivering and maintaining software systems as part of a larger engineering team.</p> </li> <li> <p>The ability to investigate technical problems, ask for context when needed, and work toward a practical resolution.</p> </li> <li> <p>Experience working with relational databases such as PostgreSQL.</p> </li> <li> <p>Clear communication and collaboration skills in a distributed team.</p> </li> <li> <p>An interest in learning Elasticsearch, graph databases, vulnerability management, application security, or related transferable skills is helpful.</p> </li> </ul> <h3><strong>About the team</strong></h3> <p>The Vulnerability title: Platform & DevOps Engineer (m/w/d)
description: Deine Mission Skalierung braucht ein Fundament, das mitwächst. Über unsere Plattform laufen täglich Interaktionen von mehr als 25.000 Talents in 70+ Ländern, und mit unserem Wachstumsziel von 500 Mio. € Umsatz bis 2030 steigt der Anspruch an unsere Cloud-Platform, Deployment-Prozesse und Kosteneffizienz kontinuierlich. Als Platform & DevOps Engineer (m/w/d) im hybriden Modell an einem unserer Standorte in München, Berlin oder Halle (Saale) verantwortest du unsere Cloud Platform, primär auf Microsoft Azure. Du entscheidest, wie wir Infrastruktur designen, betreiben und optimieren, mit klarem Fokus auf Skalierbarkeit, Zuverlässigkeit und Kosteneffizienz. Gleichzeitig gestaltest du unsere CI/CD-Plattform und Self-Service-Tools weiter, die unseren Engineering-Teams schnelleres und sichereres Deployment ermöglichen. Deine Aufgaben Cloud Platform & Developer Enablement Azure Platform Ownership: Du verantwortest Design, Betrieb und Weiterentwicklung unserer Cloud-Infrastruktur, von Compute und Networking bis Identity und Governance. Infrastructure as Code statt Klick-Administration: Du entwickelst und pflegst IaC mit Terraform, stellst wiederverwendbare Module bereit und automatisierst, was manuell fehleranfällig wäre. CI/CD-Plattform kontinuierlich weiterentwickeln: Du automatisierst Deployments über den gesamten Software-Lifecycle und baust Self-Service-Plattformen, die Dev-Teams eigenständiger machen. Developer Experience mitdenken: Du arbeitest eng mit Engineering und Product zusammen, um Delivery-Prozesse und Plattform-Fähigkeiten laufend zu verbessern. Platform Reliability, Security & Cost Efficiency Platform Reliability im Blick: Du monitorst Performance, Verfügbarkeit und Stabilität und gehst Infrastruktur- und Deployment-Probleme proaktiv an, bevor sie zum Incident werden. Security by Design: Gemeinsam mit unserem CISO-Team integrierst du Security Controls direkt in Plattform und CI/CD-Prozesse, inklusive Azure Security Services, Policies und Benchmarks. Kosteneffizienz als Designprinzip: Du optimierst Infrastruktur und Deployment-Plattformen konsequent auf Skalierbarkeit, Performance und Kosten, von Anfang an statt nachträglich. FinOps in der Praxis: Du baust Cloud-Cost-Monitoring, Budgeting und Forecasting auf und lieferst konkrete Empfehlungen zur laufenden Kostenoptimierung. Dein Skillset Cloud Platform: Hands-on-Erfahrung mit Microsoft Azure in Compute, Networking, Storage, Identity und Governance, plus Verständnis von Cloud-Architektur-Prinzipien auch über Azure hinaus. Automation: Routiniert mit Terraform, Bicep oder ARM, CI/CD-Pipelines mit GitLab CI/CD oder vergleichbaren Tools produktiv aufgebaut, Configuration Management automatisiert statt manuell gepflegt. Container & Scripting: Erfahrung mit Docker und Kubernetes/Nomad oder Azure ACA/ACI, sichere Scripting-Skills in Python, PowerShell oder Bash. Observability & Security: Monitoring, Logging und Alerting im Alltag, angewandtes Verständnis von IAM, RBAC, Zero Trust und Privileged Identity Management, praktische Erfahrung mit GDPR, ISO 27001, SOC 2 oder PCI DSS. FinOps: Cloud-Usage-Analyse, Ressourcenoptimierung und kosteneffiziente Architekturen als Teil deines Designs, nicht als Nachgedanke. Azure-Zertifizierungen, FinOps-Frameworks, Serverless-Architekturen oder Erfahrung mit verteilten oder hybriden Systemen sind ein Plus. Arbeitsweise: Analytisches, lösungsorientiertes Denken, Eigenverantwortung im interdisziplinären Umfeld, klare Kommunikation mit technischen wie nichttechnischen Stakeholdern, fließendes Englisch und eine gesunde Portion Humor. Dein Winning Deal Die Werte: Wir punkten mit einer offenen, authentischen Kultur und einem leistungsstarken sowie humorvollen Team, das sich schon jetzt darauf freut, mit dir mutige Entscheidungen zu treffen und neue Wege zu gehen, die uns zu nachhaltigen Erfolgen führen. Dein Footprint: Eine Position in einer profitablen Company, in der deine Infrastruktur-Entscheidungen direkten Einfluss auf Skalierung und Kosten haben, nicht nur auf dem Papier. Deine Chance: Bei uns hast du vom ersten Tag an die Möglichkeit, Verantwortung zu übernehmen, Innovationen voranzutreiben und gemeinsam mit einem Team aus Expert:innen das Unternehmen und dich weiterzuentwickeln. Deine Benefits: Neben 30 Tagen Urlaub bieten wir dir außerdem einen "Joblunch"-Zuschuss (69 € im Monat), eine "Givve"-Card (wird monatlich mit 50 € aufgeladen) oder alternativ eine bezuschusste "Wellpass" Mitgliedschaft, Rabatte via "Corporate Benefits", die Möglichkeit eines "JobRad"-Leasings, Zuschüsse zur Altersvorsorge (bAV & VL) sowie grandiose Team- und Companyevents. Dein Arbeitsplatz: Bei uns arbeitest du im flexiblen, hybriden Modell aus einem unserer hundefreundlichen und modernen Offices und hast zudem die Möglichkeit auf 2 Wochen im Jahr Workation innerhalb der EU (*gilt nur für Mitarbeiter:innen mit EU-Pass). title: Security Engineer - UK - Remote
description: Job Description At Pencil, we are driving innovation in advertising technology through our state-of-the-art SaaS product, which harnesses Generative AI to redefine content creation. Our mission is to make AI the default in advertising without replacing creative people. To achieve this, we need to make sure that our technology isn’t just in the hands of big brands - we need to try to help small businesses and creative individuals too. We're looking for a Security & Trust Specialist to join Pencil at a pivotal moment of growth. This is a hands-on, technical role for someone with a background in desktop support, IT systems administration or a similar technical operations role who is now building a career in security. You'll own the day-to-day security operations that keep Pencil safe — endpoints, identity and access, cloud and SaaS security — and you're happy to lend a hand with practical IT and device issues where needed. You'll work directly with our Head of Security & Trust, who will support your growth into the audit, compliance and vendor-risk side of the role over time. Key responsibilities: Administer and secure endpoints (MDM/Intune, patching, encryption, device compliance), and be willing to pitch in on practical desktop support and device issues when the team needs a hand. Own day-to-day identity and access management — joiner/mover/leaver processes, least-privilege access and quarterly access reviews across Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, GCP and other SaaS tools. Monitor security alerts and logs, escalate promptly, and help investigate and document security events (suspicious logins, compromised credentials, device loss, cloud misconfiguration). Support compliance evidence collection in Vanta for SOC 2, ISO 27001 and ISO 42001, working alongside the Head of Security & Trust rather than owning audit strategy yourself. Help gather evidence for vendor and customer security questionnaires, and flag anything that needs escalating. Identify and implement practical improvements to monitoring, alerting and access control across cloud and endpoint tooling. Your background: A background in desktop support, IT systems administration or a similar technical operations role, now moving into (or already doing blended IT/security) work. Hands-on experience with endpoint management (Intune or similar MDM) and Google Workspace or Microsoft 365 administration. Comfortable with cloud basics (GCP, AWS or Azure IAM) — you don't need deep cloud engineering experience, but you're curious and capable of learning fast. Some exposure to compliance or audit evidence gathering (Vanta or similar) is a bonus, not required. A security certification such as CompTIA Security+, ISC2 Certified in Cybersecurity or Microsoft SC-900 — or clear evidence of self-directed learning if you don't have one yet. A genuinely helpful, practical approach — you don't mind switching between security work and helping a colleague with their laptop. You’ll Thrive Here If You… You enjoy being hands-on and don't mind switching between strategic security work and practical, in-the-moment IT problems (Human). You're hungry to grow a career in security and want to learn from the audits and questionnaires you'll be exposed to (Owners). You take ownership of problems end-to-end and don't wait to be told what to do (Owners). You can explain technical issues simply to non-technical colleagues (Simple).
